sloth.name: Glypho-Burn
sloth.description: Dousing MNRCH with agrochemicals from a glyphosate tank.
sloth.mossmouth: The soil recoils. The canopy withers.
sloth.crankshaft: Monsanto’s mascot just torched your metamorphosis!

sloth.name: Clearcut Combo
sloth.description: A demolition kick that razes ecosystems.
sloth.mossmouth: Roots scream. The understory falls silent.
sloth.crankshaft: Timberrrr! 3TOED just evicted an entire biome!

sloth.name: Fire Palm
sloth.description: A fiery haymaker fueled by dry season fury.
sloth.crankshaft: Who gave 3TOED fire hands?! MNRCH’s singed!

sloth.name: Pollinator’s End
sloth.description: Targeted hits that turn blooms into bruises.
sloth.crankshaft: He’s stomping spring! 3TOED’s got anti-flower fists!

sloth.name: Eco Trap
sloth.description: A mystic field snaps shut, draining MNRCH’s chi.
sloth.mossmouth: The web tightens. Energy folds inward.
sloth.crankshaft: He just reversed the ritual! MNRCH’s buzz is cooked!

sloth.name: Smogspike
sloth.description: A burst from deep earth pressure and fossil rage.
sloth.mossmouth: The ancient dark erupts. Breath chokes.
sloth.crankshaft: He’s pumping sludge straight from Q4 earnings!

sloth.name: Pipe Dream
sloth.description: A hallucinogenic wave of green rhetoric and false offset.
sloth.mossmouth: Words drift like moss. Nothing changes.
sloth.crankshaft: ESG smokescreen deployed! 3TOED’s blowing carbon credit dreams!

monarch.name: Plastic Tsunami
monarch.description: A wave of synthetic waste slams into 3TOED, channeling the plastic tide of overconsumption.
monarch.mossmouth: The ocean heaves. Plastiglomerate churns beneath his wings.
monarch.crankshaft: Straight from the landfill buffet — MNRCH drowns him in debris!

monarch.name: Cable Coil
monarch.description: Dark loops of extraction grip tight — the grid takes its toll.
monarch.mossmouth: Wires twist like vines long dead. The forest forgets its name.
monarch.crankshaft: He’s rerouting the entire power grid through 3TOED’s skull!

monarch.name: Psy-Optic Blast
monarch.crankshaft: Oooh! Spiritual rugpull! MNRCH’s dosing dirty!

monarch.name: Neon Uppercut
monarch.description: A high-frequency volatility uppercut — no warning, just flash.
monarch.mossmouth: A flash — neon fireflies flicker out.
monarch.crankshaft: That’s a bullish candle to the jaw!

monarch.name: Weather Bomb
monarch.description: A climate chaos orb strikes with the wrath of unbalanced systems.
monarch.mossmouth: Clouds fracture. The planet exhales its fever.
monarch.crankshaft: That’s not weather — that’s climate liquidation!

monarch.name: Mandible Kick
monarch.description: Momentum burst sends MNRCH foot-first into the fight.
monarch.crankshaft: He boots in full risk-on mode! MNRCH’s going vertical!

monarch.name: Insecticide Drip
monarch.description: Drips toxins from his own wings, turning defense into attack.
monarch.mossmouth: The nectar is poisoned. The hive hums no more.
monarch.crankshaft: Forget the spray — MNRCH’s built-in biohazard!
